title: CVE-2022-41248 (bigpanda_notifier)
summary: Jenkins BigPanda Notifier Plugin 1.4.0 and earlier does not mask the BigPanda API key on the global configuration form, increasing the potential for attackers to observe and capture it.

Description
Jenkins BigPanda Notifier Plugin 1.4.0 and earlier does not mask the BigPanda API key on the global configuration form, increasing the potential for attackers to observe and capture it.
